project.title: ShipSafe AI: Pre-PR Production-Readiness Gate on IBM Db2
project.short_description: Local-first pre-pull-request assessment engine that scans for secrets, SQL injection, risky code, vulnerable dependencies and failing tests, returns a deterministic PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNINGS / BLOCKED gate, persists every assessment in IBM Db2, and links each finding to the governing team policy via LangChain + Db2 vector search. Exposed as a CLI and an MCP server for IBM Bob.
project.category: DevSecOps / AI Developer Tooling / Vector Search

members.name: Devanshu Sharma
members.role: Solo developer: scanners, Db2 schema and persistence, LangChain Db2 vector retrieval, MCP server

features_used: Relational tables with foreign keys and ON DELETE CASCADE
Native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) column and VECTOR_DISTANCE (COSINE) search
OLAP window functions (LAG, ROW_NUMBER) in a view
